title.narrative: UNICEF augmented the WASH sector’s enabling environment through strengthening the Water Sector Coordination Facility to improve governance and supported key initiatives such as the Nation-Wide WASH Needs Assessment to enhance planning and monitoring progress. UNICEF supported the development of policies and strategies such as the Somaliland WASH Strategic Plan and the Puntland Public Private Partnership Policy.
